name: Redo liver transplantation benchmark values
description: Reported benchmark outcome values (e.g., morbidity, mortality, survival) for redo liver transplantation to contextualize performance expectations.
reputation: Clinical benchmark referenced in transplant literature but not widely adopted as a standardized ML benchmark; primarily used in medical research and outcome reporting.
notes: Non-LLM clinical outcome benchmark: small and heterogeneous cohort sizes, variable reporting standards across studies, potential publication bias and confounding in reported values; not designed for direct ML scoring without careful curation.
